    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The text is real text in headings, paragraphs and a list – pointers, carets and selections are decoration and hidden from screen readers
      - listitem: "Every suggestion is focusable and labelled, e.g. \"Researcher suggests adding: 38%\"; its window is a dialog with Accept and Reject buttons"
      - listitem: The faces are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) named after the agent and what it is doing; a followed face fills with its tint
      - listitem: New suggestions are announced politely, with the agent's note
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Pointers glide to their next place; a new one pops in where it lands, one that leaves fades out where it was
      - listitem: Images are gray with a light shimmer running across while they load, then fade in; a held image resizes smoothly while the pointer stays on its corner handle
      - listitem: A comment pin grows into its window on hover and folds back into it – the agent's mark stays and slides to the corner
      - listitem: While an agent types, its caret holds still and the pointer follows every letter
      - listitem: What an agent is doing slides out next to its name on the flag
      - listitem: Selected passages fade in behind the text in the agent's color; new suggestions fill in softly
      - listitem: While an agent is in the document, an arc in its color runs around its face, fading in from nothing – like a loader
      - listitem: Switching tabs fades the new view in; table rows an agent adds slide in
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything moves at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every position is measured from the page itself, so any width, font size or zoom works – the pointers stay on their letters while the text wraps
      - listitem: Comment windows open towards the bottom right – towards the left near the right edge, upwards near the bottom
      - listitem: Flags always sit to the bottom right of their pointer; near the right edge they are cut off rather than moved
      - listitem: Below 520px the page gets tighter margins and the suggestion count in the header gives way to the faces
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Offsets are character indexes into the block's current text – after accepting a suggestion, use the text that acceptSuggestion returns
      - listitem: "A cursor inside a suggestion (in: id) counts its offset in that suggestion's insert text"
      - listitem: Pass new cursors as your agents stream – the component animates between any two states, it doesn't need every step
